sn35.92:1.1: “Bhikkhus, I will teach you the dyad.
sn35.92:1.4: The eye and forms, the ear and sounds, the nose and odours, the tongue and tastes, the body and tactile objects, the mind and mental phenomena.
sn35.92:2.2: ‘Having rejected this dyad, I shall make known another dyad’—that would be a mere empty boast on his part.
sn35.92:2.3: If he was questioned he would not be able to reply
sn35.92:2.4: and, further, he would meet with vexation.
sn35.92:2.6: Because, bhikkhus, that would not be within his domain.”
